key.name: enabled
key.description: A Present tile in quick settings, a question when a screen is plugged in, and Super+Alt+D to draw on the screen. While presenting, the screen stays awake, banners wait and the pointer is easy to follow.

key.name: pointer-mark
key.description: halo draws a disc round the pointer, torch dims everything but a circle round it, and none leaves the pointer as it is.

key.name: ask-on-screen
key.summary: Ask to present when a screen is plugged in
key.description: Once for each screen in a session, while Present mode is offered. Nothing happens without the click.

key.name: scribble
key.description: Ink over the whole screen until Esc, while Present mode is offered.
